answer: A hardware-rooted attestation kernel signs each agent key inside a TEE; a public terrace of verifiers checks endorsement chains, and a bridge maps keys to rate-limited credits. Splitting resources across keys does not increase rewards because issuance is capped per attested root, not per bond, and no single bond proves one person. Attackers must forge TEEs or buy devices; limitations include compromised enclaves and supply-chain risk.
